payload.title: File:Gansus zheni (BMNHC Ph1392) gastroliths NMNS.jpg
payload.description_html: Gastroliths in Gansus zheni specimen BMNHC Ph1392, which may suggest an herbivorous diet of this Cretaceous waterbird. The specimen is collected from Lingyuan, Liaoning, China and is a collection of Beijing Museum of Natural History. It was on display in the National Museum of Natural Science (Taichung, Taiwan) during a special exhibition.
